lines.zh: 我沿着走廊慢慢走，脚步声很空。
lines.en: I walk the corridor; my steps sound hollow.

lines.zh: 布偶的关节一格格转动。
lines.en: My joints turn notch by notch.
My hand is raised, as if to take someone's.
My white face catches the light.

lines.zh: 我经过监控摄像头，它会亮。
lines.en: Cameras overhead flicker as I pass.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，像没有重量。
lines.en: I walk lightly, as if weightless.

lines.zh: 长长的身体在门框里折了一下。
lines.en: My tall body folds through the doorway.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，不碰任何东西。
lines.en: I keep to the walls and touch nothing.
My sleeves hang to my knees.
I stop, then start again.
I turn my head slowly.
I always route around the lights.
A music-box tune follows me.
Standing, hands lowered.
The music box plays in my arms.
Under the white mask, no expression.
I tilt my head as if listening.
When the lights go out, I remain.
I am still, yet not quite stopped.
Threads hang from my wrists.
I blink, slowly.

lines.zh: 房间角落里有影子，我不看。
lines.en: A shadow in the corner. I do not look.
I set my head straight again.
An old seam runs across my cloth.
I count the lights in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 关节卡了一下，我推回去。
lines.en: A joint locks; I push it back.
I have always been in this building.
I wait for a gift.
Stay where you are.
I know your face.
You cannot leave anymore.
Beneath the mask there is nothing.
Lights off, and here I am.
Do not run. The halls are long.
I have watched you a long while.
Your shadow is on the wall.
This floor has no exit.
Turn your head. Look at me.
I will not harm you unless you move.

lines.zh: 你手里的手电，照不到我。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach me.
We are all still here.
Be quiet, would you?
Did you lock the door?
I see the way you breathe.
The time has come.
Do not turn off the light. Please.
I have been waiting for a gift.
A tear opens in my cloth.
I floated back a little.
Something inside was touched.
I tilt my head and look at you.
One of my threads snapped.
That actually hurt.
The music skips a beat.
I straighten myself up.
Is that a gift for me?
I reach out. No need to fear.
Place it in my hand.

lines.zh: 音乐盒不响了，我需要它。
lines.en: The music stopped. I need it.
What did you bring in?
I am not greedy. One thing is enough.
Gifts are scarce in this building.
Give it, and I will step aside.
What you hold is shining.
I have received nothing in a long time.
Hand it over. Slowly.
What are you hiding behind you?

lines.zh: 给我，我就让你少受点苦。
lines.en: Give it, and I spare you some pain.
A gift. I want a gift.
I count to the third.
You touched me just now.
Too late to run now.
There are no bones under this cloth.
Stand there. Do not lean on me.
I swayed like paper.
This corridor is too narrow.
You should not have turned.
This time I let you pass.
I am only a doll.
It is empty inside. Do you understand?
This building keeps no such thing.
My strings are pulled by someone else.
I do not have that.
You are asking a cloth doll.
The music box is my only company.
I only want to be left alone.
Do not touch me. Keep back.
A gift matters more than that.
This thread is mine.
I bend; my joints creak.
That one on the floor is old.
I pick it up and look at it.
This is no gift at all.
Your hands are quicker than mine.

lines.zh: 这栋楼的东西都是我的。
lines.en: Everything in this building is mine.
I will keep it for you.
The box opened — you touched it, right?
Now you can only go forward.
You broke the rule.
There is no door at the end.
You are on my floor.
Listen. The music stopped.
This time I will not let go.
I remember your face.

lines.zh: 我低着头，眼睛却一直看你。
lines.en: My head is down, but my eyes stay on you.

lines.zh: 我身上的线，牵着你的脚。
lines.en: The strings on me pull at your feet.
Your torch grows dim.
I have no need of speed.
Turn and look behind you.
The corridor closes behind you.
I listen to your steps.
A little further forward.
A doll does not breathe.
I never tire.
The music box stops, and I come out.
My hand closes on your throat.
Something reaches out from under the cloth.
You are pressed against the wall.
This is not a blow. It is a grip.
Your feet leave the floor.
Do not struggle. It will be quicker.
Listen. The music plays again.
When I let go, you are still here.
I come from the end of the hall.
The music box starts first.
The lights flickered twice.

lines.zh: 音乐盒一停，我就该来了。
lines.en: When the music box stops, I am due.

lines.zh: 音乐盒停了，我慢慢站起来。
lines.en: The music box stops and I rise slowly.
My white face surfaces from the shade.
The door opened on its own.
This floor is mine now.
Do you hear me?
Did you bring a gift?

lines.zh: 火爬上布料，我慢慢拍掉。
lines.en: Fire climbs my cloth. I brush it off slowly.

lines.zh: 我倒下时，关节脱了一半。
lines.en: Falling, half my joints come apart.
The cloth fills with water and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，扎在背后的墙上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me into the wall.
This light can see me.
I do not eat, yet I weaken.
Lightning burns my threads.

lines.zh: 我掉下去时还听着音乐。
lines.en: I fall, still hearing the music.
